briefing.headline: Growth is cooling but employment stays firm, keeping the soft landing intact.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Real GDP softened to 2.1 percent for Q3 2026, slowing from prior quarter but still positive.
Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 sits just above the Fed's target, letting policy space open.

briefing.whats_new: Today: Real GDP softer, from 2.2 percent to 2.1 percent.
